All three exponents are multiples of 3 (27, 18, 9), so each term is 1 and the sum is 3 — true even for ω=1.

x³+y³+z³=3xyz ⇔ (x+y+z)(x²+y²+z²−xy−yz−zx)=0. If x+y+z=0: (x+yω+zω²)³+(x+yω²+zω)³ = 27xyz and (x+y+z)³=0. If instead x=y=z: the first two terms vanish and (3x)³ = 27x³ = 27xyz. Both branches give 27xyz.
